AboutHero.title: ABOUT ME
AboutHero.name: I'm Ahmed Mohamed Abdelal
AboutHero.description: Web developer specializing in MERN Stack with 3 years of experience building web applications. Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering from Cairo University. I focus on building practical solutions with clean code.
AboutHero.altText: Ahmed Mohamed Abdelal - Full Stack Developer

paragraphs.p1: My journey in software development started during my Computer Engineering studies. It began with curiosity about how applications work, then grew into a genuine passion for building practical digital solutions.
paragraphs.p2: Over the past three years, I've worked on various projects including management systems and integrated web applications. These projects helped deepen my understanding of Full Stack development and improve my MERN Stack skills.
paragraphs.p3: In my work, I focus on combining technical aspects with user experience. I believe good applications should be easy to use, fast, and work efficiently across different devices.
paragraphs.p4: I continuously work on developing my skills and learning about the latest web technologies. Outside of work, I explore open-source projects and experiment with new development tools.
